notes: Shopify storefront, direct HTTP fetch worked throughout (tier 1), no WAF/blocking. Checked: main mega-menu (desktop + mobile), footer nav, /collections.json (182 collections), site search (/search?q=), sitemap.xml -> sitemap_collections_1.xml. Found two genuine, live, nav-linked Bestsellers PLPs: (1) 'Bestsellers' (/collections/bestsellers) - a top-level mega-menu item present in both desktop megamenu and mobile menu, plus a homepage hero CTA 'Shop Bestsellers'; confirmed a real product grid renders (not a placeholder/disabled page - verified by comparing against the site's genuine 404 page and against the disabled-collection placeholder text 'Something Special is on the Horizon / This content is currently unavailable' which does NOT appear on this page). (2) 'Kids Bestsellers' (/collections/kids-bestsellers) - surfaced via a promotional banner inside the Kids mega-submenu ('Bestsellers for Kids' / 'Shop Bestsellers' CTA), also renders a real product grid. Treated as a genuine second, differently-scoped Bestsellers listing per Sec.3 'Multiple PLPs for the same concept' (different product set/count from the main Bestsellers listing, not an alias of it) rather than as a nested child of the main Bestsellers row, since the site does not nest it under the main Bestsellers nav item. qty for both verified by the strict exhaustion method: fully paginated /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250&page=N to an empty page and counted unique numeric product IDs, which exactly matched the products_count field returned by /collections.json for both handles (bestsellers: 1480 across pages 1-6 of 250/250/250/250/250/230/0; kids-bestsellers: 148 on page 1, 0 on page 2). The Bestsellers qty (1480) is a large fraction of the catalog but the store's product sitemap is split across 3 files consistent with a catalog in the low thousands, and the listing is unambiguously presented site-wide as the dedicated Bestsellers merchandising page (not a filter/search result), so it was kept as-is rather than treated as suspect. No other Bestsellers-type candidates found (no 'Top Sellers', 'Popular', 'Trending', 'Customer Favorites' handles in the collections list).

rows.evidence: Exhaustive pagination of /collections/bestsellers/products.json?limit=250 across pages 1-7 (250,250,250,250,250,230,0 products) = 1480 unique product IDs; matches products_count=1480 in /collections.json for handle 'bestsellers'

Exhaustive pagination of /collections/kids-bestsellers/products.json?limit=250 across pages 1-2 (148, 0 products) = 148 unique product IDs; matches products_count=148 in /collections.json for handle 'kids-bestsellers'
